newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Large trades in Indah Kiat - brokers.
newsitem.headline: Large trades in Indah Kiat - brokers.

text.p: Shares of Indonesia's PT Indah Kiat Pulp and Paper were cross traded in large amounts on Thursday, mostly by local brokerage firms, brokers said.

Some 231.8 million Indah Kiat shares, slightly over four percent of the company's total equity, were crossed, with brokerage firm Makindo believed to have crossed the largest number followed by Amantara Securities, brokers said.
"Makindo crossed a large number of Indah Kiat shares. I have not heard the participating parties, but the amount was quite large," one sales manager with a large local brokerage firm said.
Indah Kiat closed unchanged at 1,350 rupiah after touching a day low of 1,000 rupiah and a day high of 1,425 rupiah on the cross board.

One broker said he had heard that most of the buying was done by Asia Food and Properties, a Singapore company controlled by Indonesia's Sinar Mas group which also has a controlling stake in Indah Kiat.
"It's possible that Sinar Mas was transferring shares in Indah Kiat from local vehicles to offshore vehicles," the broker said.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
The huge crossing of Indah Kiat boosted total market turn-over to around 900 billion rupiah on Thursday against a daily average of around 500 billion rupiah, brokers said.
